03 / MACOS

macOS

DMG packages for Apple Silicon and Intel. Choose the package that matches your Mac, then drag CurveMole to Applications.

macOS release downloads ↗

Downloads open the official GitHub release page. Packages include SHA256SUMS.txt for verification.

Windows and macOS downloads are unsigned

CurveMole is a nonprofit project. Signing and certification require fees paid by the developer, so these packages are distributed unsigned. You may need to authorize the first launch.

  • Windows: If SmartScreen shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info → Run anyway .
  • macOS: Drag CurveMole from the DMG to Applications and try opening it once. If blocked, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway , then confirm Open and authenticate if asked.

Only approve an official download you trust. Check SHA256SUMS.txt on the release page.

DEVELOPMENT RELEASES

Beta releases

Beta versions provide upcoming fixes and features earlier and may introduce new bugs. In CurveMole, select Help → Update channel… → Beta.

Browse releases & betas ↗
PYTHON & SOURCE

Python distributions and source code

Release assets include Python wheels and source distributions. The Python API, command line and YAML workflows use the same fitting engine as the desktop application.

Python & source packages ↗ Read the documentation ↗

You can return to Stable at any time. An installed beta waits for an equal or newer stable release; changing channel never downgrades automatically.
